Hero.subtitle: Jeannine and Emmanuel Foundation · Rwanda
Hero.title: Kuyoborwa n'impuhwe. Guteza imbere abaturage. Guharanira impinduka zirambye.
Hero.description: Dukorana n'imiryango itishoboye mu Rwanda — tubungabunga ibidukikije, twongera ubushobozi bw'imibereho, kandi twubaka ejo hazaza heza kandi harengera bose.

Mission.title_mission: Gukorera Abaturage. Kubungabunga Ibidukikije. Kubaka Ejo Hazaza.
Mission.desc_mission: Umuryango wa Jeannine na Emmanuel washinzwe kugira ngo ufashwe abatishoboye kurusha abandi mu Rwanda — ababayeho mu bukene, abagore n'abana, urubyiruko, abageze mu zabukuru, ndetse n'amatsinda y'abantu basigaye inyuma. Dukora ibikorwa byo kubungabunga ibidukikije, uburezi, ubuzima rusange, n'imicungire irambye y'amazi, dufatanyije n'abaturage dukorera.
Mission.quote_who: "Kuyoborwa n'impuhwe. Guteza imbere abaturage. Guharanira impinduka zirambye."
Mission.desc_who: Umuryango wa Jeannine na Emmanuel (JEF) ni umuryango udaharanira inyungu washinzwe hagamijwe guteza imbere imibereho myiza y'abaturage, kubungabunga ibidukikije, no gushyigikira iterambere rirambye mu Rwanda. Twaashinzwe dushingiye ku ndangagaciro z'agaciro k'ikiremwamuntu, ubunyangamugayo, ubufatanye, n'ubusabane, dukorana n'amatsinda y'abatishoboye — harimo abafite amikoro make, abagore n'abana bari mu bukene, ndetse n'abandi basigaye inyuma.

FocusAreas.area1_desc: Gushyigikira amatsinda y'abatishoboye — abangavu babyaye, abageze mu zabukuru, n'imiryango ifite amikoro make — binyuze mu nkunga y'ubutabazi, kongerera ubushobozi, n'imishinga ibateza imbere.
FocusAreas.area2_desc: Kurinda imigezi, ibishanga, n'urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima mu Rwanda binyuze mu gutera ibiti, kubungabunga inzuzi, no gukangurira abaturage kwita ku kirere.
FocusAreas.area3_desc: Kwongera amahirwe y'uburezi n'ubumenyi ngiro ku rubyiruko n'abandi batiteje imbere binyuze mu buruse, ubunganizi mu myigire, n'ubufatanye n'ibigo bitanga amahugurwa.
FocusAreas.area4_desc: Kubungabunga no gucunga neza umutungo w'amazi binyuze mu mishinga y'amazi rusange, amahugurwa yo kubungabunga ibidukikije, no geza amazi meza ku baturage.

Impact.title: Wifatanya Natwe mu Kubaka Ejo Hazaza Heza
Impact.desc: Nk'umuryango mushya, buri nkunga yose ifite agaciro. Yaba ari ugutanga inkunga, ubukorerabushake, cyangwa kugeza ubutumwa bwacu ku bandi — uba uri gufasha kubaka umusingi w'ikintu kizaramba nyuma yacu twese. Wifatanya natwe mu Karere ka Rusizi n'ahandi.

BlogPreview.label: Amakuru Mashya
BlogPreview.title: Inkuru & Amakuru
BlogPreview.default_excerpt: Soma inkuru yose ngo umenye byinshi ku makuru yacu aheruka.

Footer.newsletter_desc: Iyandikishe kugira ngo ujye ubona amakuru agezweho ku mishinga yacu, inkuru z'iterambere, ndetse n'amahirwe yo gushyigikira imiryango mu Rwanda.
Footer.about_desc: Twiyemeje kuzamura imibereho myiza no kubungabunga ibidukikije ku bisekuru by'ubu n'ibizaza mu Rwanda. Ibikorwa byacu birengera abatishoboye bikanabubakira ubwigenge burambye.

About.header_subtitle: Kuyoborwa n'impuhwe. Guteza imbere abaturage. Guharanira impinduka zirambye.
About.who_title: Umuryango ushingiye ku mpuhwe, ibikorwa, n'impinduka.
About.who_desc1: Umuryango wa Jeannine na Emmanuel (JEF) ni umuryango udaharanira inyungu washinzwe hagamijwe guteza imbere imibereho myiza y'abaturage, kubungabunga ibidukikije, no gushyigikira iterambere rirambye mu Rwanda.
About.who_desc2: Twiyemeje kugendera ku ndangagaciro z'agaciro k'ikiremwamuntu, ubunyangamugayo, ubufatanye, inshingano mu muryango, n'uburinganire, twita ku matsinda y'abatishoboye, harimo abafite amikoro make, abagore n'abana bari mu bukene, urubyiruko, n'abandi basigaye inyuma.
About.who_desc3: JEF ikora ibikorwa by'ubutabazi, kubungabunga ibidukikije, imicungire y'amazi, uburezi n'imyuga, n'ibikorwa byo guteza imbere imibereho myiza nk'imikino, imirire, n'isuku. Dufatanya n'ibigo bya leta, abikorera, n'imiryango itari iya leta kugira ngo tugere ku mpinduka zirambye n'iterambere ry'igihugu.
About.mission_desc: Guteza imbere imibereho y'abaturage, kubungabunga ibidukikije, no gushyigikira iterambere rirambye.
About.vision_desc: Abaturage bafite ubuzima bwiza, biyoboye kandi bubahiriza ibidukikije aho buri wese, cyane cyane abatishoboye, bafite amahirwe yo gutera imbere.
About.v1_desc: Dukorera mu mucyo n'ubunyangamugayo mu mishinga yacu yose, ubufatanye, n'imikoreshereze y'umutungo.
About.v2_desc: Dushyira abantu ku mutima mu byo dukora byose, tugaragariza impuhwe, icyubahiro n'agaciro bose dukorera.
About.v3_desc: Twiyemeje kugeza ku mpinduka nziza mu muryango binyuze mu gukora inshingano zacu neza no kuzamura imibereho y'abaturage.
About.v4_desc: Dukorana bya hafi n'abaturage, ibigo, n'abafatanyabikorwa mu iterambere kugira ngo tugere ku bisubizo biturutse mu baturage.
About.v5_desc: Twizeza amahirwe angana kuri bose, twibanda cyane ku bagore, urubyiruko, abana, n'amatsinda y'abatishoboye.
About.exist_title: Gushaka Ibisubizo by'Ejo mu Bibazo by'Uyu Munsi
About.exist_desc: Abaturage mu Rwanda — cyane cyane mu bice nka Rusizi — bafite ibibazo by'ibidukikije, amazi, uburezi n'ubukungu, ndetse n'ubwirinzi bw'abatishoboye. Umuryango Jeannine na Emmanuel ntiwashinzwe gusa gutanga ubufasha bw'igihe gito, ahubwo ni ukubaka uburyo burambye butuma abaturage biyambura ubukene.
About.approach_item1: Ibisubizo biva mu baturage — Duhimba imishinga dufatanyije n'abaturage, atari kubatekereza gusa.
About.approach_item2: Iterambere ryuzuye — Buri gikorwa kigamije impinduka zirambye, atari ugutegereza ubufasha gusa.
About.approach_item3: Kurengera abatishoboye — Abagore, abana, urubyiruko, n'abageze mu zabukuru ni bo twitaho cyane.
About.approach_item4: Uburinganire — Twimakaza uruhare n'ubuyobozi bw'abagore mu mishinga yacu yose.
About.approach_item5: Imicungire isangiwe — Amajwi y'abaturage ni yo agena uko amaprogoro akorwa n'uko apimwa.
About.cta_desc: Umuryango Jeannine na Emmanuel uri mu ntangiriro z'urugendo. Inkunga yawe — yaba iy'amafaranga cyangwa iyindi — ifite agaciro gakomeye mu byo twubaka.

Projects.header_subtitle: Porogaramu zirindwi. Inshingano imwe: kuzamura abatishoboye no kurinda ibidukikije.
Projects.intro_title: Ibikorwa Byacu, Bishingiye ku Ukuri k'u Rwanda
Projects.intro_desc: Umuryango Jeannine na Emmanuel ukora mu bice birindwi, buri kimwe kigamije gukemura ikibazo kihariye cy'abatishoboye mu Rwanda. Ibikorwa byacu mu Karere ka Rusizi ni wo mushinga wacu wa mbere — uhuriza hamwe izi porogaramu zose kugira ngo zifashe abagenerwabikorwa badasaga 12,000.
Projects.p1_desc: Duha ubufasha bwihariye abatishoboye — harimo abangavu babyaye, abagore, urubyiruko, abageze mu zabukuru, n'ingo zifite amikoro make — binyuze mu butabazi, kongerera ubushobozi, n'imishinga ibateza imbere.
Projects.p1_act4: Porogaramu z'imibereho myiza ku bangavu babyaye n'abageze mu zabukuru
Projects.p2_desc: Porogaramu yacu y'ibidukikije yimakaza ubwudahangarwa ku mihindagurikire y'ikirere no kurengera urusobe rw'ibinyabuzima mu Rwanda. Dukorana n'abaturage mu kubungabunga inzuzi, ibishanga, no kwigisha uburyo burambye bwo gucunga ubutaka n'amazi.
Projects.p2_act4: Kwigisha iby'ibidukikije mu mashuri n'aho abaturage batuye
Projects.p3_desc: Twongera amahirwe y'uburezi n'ubumenyi ngiro ku rubyiruko n'abandi basigaye inyuma, tubafungurira inzira y'akazi binyuze mu buruse, ubunganizi, n'ubufatanye n'ibigo by'imyuga.
Projects.p3_act5: Ubufatanye n'ibigo by'imyuga mu gushaka akazi
Projects.p4_desc: Amazi meza kandi ahagije ni ingenzi ku buzima bw'abaturage. Porogaramu yacu y'amazi irengera amasoko, ikigisha abaturage kuyacunga neza, kandi igashyigikira imishinga ituma amazi agera kuri bose.
Projects.p4_act1: Imishinga yo kugeza amazi meza ku baturage
Projects.p4_act3: Amahugurwa yo gukoresha no gucunga amazi neza
Projects.p5_desc: Twiteza imbere ubuzima bw'abaturage — binyuze mu gukumira no kwigisha. Porogaramu yacu y'ubuzima ishyira imbere isuku, imirire myiza, n'ubuzima buzira umuze mu bice bikeneye ubufasha.
Projects.p5_act4: Gushishikariza abaturage kubaho mu buzima buzira umuze
Projects.p6_desc: Urubyiruko ni ejo hazaza h'u Rwanda — porogaramu yacu ituma bagira uruhare mu kuhibaka. Twubaka ubuyobozi, kwihangira imirimo, n'uruhare rw'umuturage kugira ngo urubyiruko ruyobore impinduka z'aho batuye.
Projects.p6_act3: Gushyigikira kwihangira imirimo no gufashwa mu bitekerezo
Projects.p6_act4: Gutoza uruhare rw'abaturage mu kubazwa inshingano
Projects.p7_desc: Imikino ni uburyo bukomeye bw'ubusabane. Porogaramu yacu y'imikino ituma abaturage bahurira hamwe, bakagira ubuzima bwiza, kandi bakungurana ibitekerezo mu rurimi rwa bose.
Projects.p7_act4: Imikino idakumira ku bakobwa n'abafite ubumuga
Projects.rusizi_title: Kongera Imibereho Myiza, Kurengera Ibidukikije, n'Imicungire y'Amazi mu Karere ka Rusizi
Projects.rusizi_desc: Akarere ka Rusizi gafite ibibazo by'ibidukikije, amazi, n'isuku, ndetse n'amikoro make ku rubyiruko n'abatishoboye. Umuryango Jeannine na Emmanuel uri gushyira mu bikorwa umushinga w'amezi 24 wo kurengera ibidukikije, gukoresha amazi neza, no kuzamura abaturage binyuze mu burezi n'iterambere.
Projects.rusizi_focus_val: Kurengera ibidukikije, isuku (WASH), urubyiruko, ubuzima, imikino, n'iterambere rirambye
Projects.rusizi_fund_val: Irangije ku baterankunga bose, imiryango, n'abikorera
Projects.cta_desc: Nk'umuryango mushya, dusoje inyigo y'imishinga kandi dushaka abafatanyabikorwa n'abaterankunga bemera impinduka. Inkunga yawe ni yo ituma iyi mishinga iva mu mpapuro igashyirwa mu bikorwa.
Projects.cta_btn: Tanga Inkunga yo Gushyigikira uyu Mushinga

Contact.header_subtitle: Yaba uri umuterankunga, umufatanyabikorwa, cyangwa umukorerabushake — twishimiye kukumva.
Contact.intent1_title: Tanga Inkunga cyangwa Tera Inkunga Umushinga
Contact.intent1_desc: Shyigikira ibikorwa byacu muri Rusizi mu buryo bw'amafaranga.
Contact.intent2_desc: Shaka uburyo twafatanya mu mishinga n'ibigo.
Contact.intent3_desc: Wifatanya natwe mu bikorwa bifasha abaturage.
Contact.info_desc: Ufite ikibazo cyangwa igitekerezo? Koresha iyi fomu utwandikire, cyangwa ukoreshe uburyo buri hano hepfo. Tuzagusubiza mu masaha 48.

Donate.header_subtitle: Buri nkunga yose yubaka ikintu gifatika.
Donate.impact_title: Buri Nkunga Yose Yubaka Ikintu Gifatika
Donate.impact_desc: Umuryango Jeannine na Emmanuel uracyari mu ntangiriro. Inkunga yawe igenda toka mu mushinga wacu wa mbere muri Rusizi — ugera ku bantu barenga 12,000 binyuze mu kurengera ibidukikije, ubuzima, uburezi, n'amazi meza. Abaterankunga ba mbere nkawe ni bo batuma uyu murimo utangira.
Donate.equiv1_val: Isaho y'isuku ku muryango mu gihe cy'ukwezi
Donate.equiv2_val: Gutera ibiti 50 mu Karere ka Rusizi
Donate.feat1_desc: Ibiranga ibikorwa byose birinzwe kandi bikoresha ikoranabuhanga rya Flutterwave.
Donate.feat2_desc: 100% by'inkunga yawe bijya mu mishinga yacu ifasha abaturage.
Donate.feat3_desc: Shyigikira ibikorwa byacu mu buryo buhoraho binyuze mu nkunga ya buri kwezi.
Donate.trust_generic: Ubu buryo bwishyu burawe kandi bwizewe na Flutterwave
Donate.trust2: Inkunga zakirwa mu madorari (USD) — abaterankunga mpuza-mahanga bashobora kwishyura binyuze muri banki zabo
Donate.trust2_rwf: Inkunga zose zakirwa mu Mafaranga y'u Rwanda (RWF)
Donate.trust3: Umuryango Jeannine and Emmanuel Foundation ni umuryango udaharanira inyungu wemewe mu Rwanda
Donate.trust4: Ufite ikibazo? Twandikire mbere yo gutanga inkunga — twiteguye kugusubiza
Donate.method_card_desc: Ishyura ukoresheje Visa, Mastercard, cyangwa izindi karita
Donate.secure_notice: Iyi raporo irinzwe kandi ikoresha ikoranabuhanga rya Flutterwave.
Donate.success_desc: Inkunga yawe twayakiriye kandi izafasha mu mishinga yacu yo mu Karere ka Rusizi.
Donate.cancel_desc: Kwishyura kwawe ntibyagezweho. Nta mafaranga yakuweho. Urashobora kongera kugerageza igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
Donate.where_desc: Turacyanonosora ingengo y'imari y'umushinga wa Rusizi. Nibimara kwemezwa, tuzatangaza uko inkunga zikoreshwa mu mucyo. Kugeza ubu, inkunga zose zakirwa zibikirwa ibikorwa by'uyu mushinga.
